papers.key_result: Adaptive Focal Attention (focal lengths {3,9,80}) for sports video QA: +1.2pp accuracy over baseline; portable to NGS tracking-sequence play-outcome QA
papers.title: Sports-QA: A Large-Scale Video Question Answering Benchmark for Complex and Professional Sports

papers.key_result: Inject classifier predictions as text into a QLoRA-tuned VLM to generate referee-style explanations (3.8 vs 4.0 human rating); pattern ports to GSE show-your-work pick narratives
papers.title: X-VARS: Introducing Explainability in Football Refereeing with Multi-Modal Large Language Models

papers.key_result: DistilBERT headline log-odds + VADER lagged sentiment with ridge cuts Nifty 50 RMSE 134.85->128.74; method ports to NFL closing-line movement prediction (with the paper's level-target flaw fixed)
papers.title: Understanding the Impact of News Articles on the Movement of Market Index: A Case on Nifty 50

papers.key_result: 72h pre-event Reddit buzz features -> R²=0.99 viewership, but random split + sport one-hot make it an artifact; the feature recipe is reusable with temporal validation for GSE content prioritization
papers.title: Buzz to Broadcast: Predicting Sports Viewership Using Social Media Engagement

papers.key_result: ELECTRA macro-F1 0.6946 on manipulative/deceptive/responsible gambling-ad classification; ports to GSE affiliate promo-copy compliance screening (deceptive class F1 0.511 is the bar to clear)
papers.title: BetXplain: An Explanation-Annotated Dataset for Detecting Manipulative Betting Advertisements on Social Media

papers.key_result: NFL fandom radii (Ravens 121 km to Seahawks 782 km), sublinear population scaling (alpha=0.53), asymmetric winner/loser sentiment arcs; portable as engagement/targeting features
papers.title: The triumphs and tragedies of fandom: Emotional arcs in NFL tweets

papers.key_result: 47 Stathead rookie-season features -> K-best 13 -> MLP AUC 0.674 for UCL/Tommy John injury; compact honest tabular protocol worth porting to NFL rookie injury risk
papers.title: Predicting Ulnar Collateral Ligament Injury in Rookie Major League Baseball Pitchers

papers.key_result: Posterior Predictive Treatment Assignment: stochastic inclusion via posterior-predictive treatment mismatch; two-stage modular Bayesian ATO estimator beating IPTW under poor overlap; for GSE's few-treated-unit causal questions
papers.title: Posterior Predictive Treatment Assignment for Estimating Causal Effects with Limited Overlap

papers.key_result: Hi-CI autoencoder with mixed L2,1 mean-difference regularization for high-dimensional covariates + continuous treatments: NEWS100 PEHE 8.14 vs 48.39/49.64 baselines; for GSE heterogeneous dose-response (snap/target share)
papers.title: Hi-CI: Deep Causal Inference with High-Dimensional and Highly Correlated Variables

papers.key_result: REJECT: rugby tackle pipeline with 41% clip-processing failure, manual tuning on evaluation clips, F1 0.50 / kappa 0.28, no prospective injury target; replaced by reserve chain 1312->1313
papers.title: Automated Tackle Injury Risk Assessment

papers.key_result: Bagged-PCMCI+: moving-block bootstrap + edge-wise majority vote stabilizes time-series causal discovery; gains largest for short samples/high autocorrelation; confidence frequencies MAE ~3% lagged; B>=100 recommended
papers.title: Bootstrap Aggregation for Time Series Causal Discovery

papers.key_result: Model-free quantile association estimand with EIF + cross-fitted TMLE: plug-in bias -70e-2/coverage 0.1% -> TMLE bias 1.2e-2/coverage 97.2%; for GSE distributional prop analysis with honest CIs
papers.title: Assumption-Lean Quantile Regression via Efficient Influence Functions

papers.key_result: REJECT (reserve 1312, replacing 1123): near-duplicate of existing ledger 0772 (same Monmouth lab/PART framework/9-player cohort; cites 0772's ICHMS 2025 source paper); n=9 self-reported labels, AUC 0.64-0.65; chain continued to 1313
papers.title: Multimodal Injury Risk and Performance Prediction in Tennis Using Weighted Ensemble Learning

papers.key_result: CaffeNet double-cascade transfer (ImageNet->GRF/M->KJM) predicts 3D knee joint moments from 8-marker kinematics: sidestep r=0.9277 (L), combined 0.8895; +4.2% over single fine-tune (p<0.01); 5-fold CV clean; for ACL load-monitoring lane
papers.title: On-field player workload exposure and knee injury risk monitoring via deep learning
